description.en: From about thirty Dutch families on Noten Eylandt in 1624 to about 8.6 million New Yorkers today — the year and the population stay on screen the whole way.
description.tr: 1624'te Noten Eylandt'a çıkan otuz kadar Hollandalı aileden bugün yaklaşık 8,6 milyon New Yorkluya — yıl ve nüfus baştan sona ekranda.

title.en: How New Amsterdam Became New York, 1624–1699 #shorts
title.tr: Yeni Amsterdam Nasıl New York Oldu, 1624–1699 #shorts

description.en: 1624: Dutch families land on Noten Eylandt. 1625: Fort Amsterdam. 1653: a wall across the island — today's Wall Street. September 1664: English frigates arrive and the town is renamed New York. 1673: briefly Dutch again as New Orange. 1699: the wall comes down.
description.tr: 1624: Hollandalı aileler Noten Eylandt'a çıkar. 1625: Amsterdam Kalesi. 1653: adayı boydan boya kesen bir sur — bugünkü Wall Street. Eylül 1664: İngiliz fırkateynleri gelir ve kasabanın adı New York olur. 1673: kısa bir süre yeniden Hollandalı, Yeni Orange. 1699: sur yıkılır.

title.en: From the Brooklyn Bridge to the Empire State in 50 Seconds #shorts

description.en: 1883: the Brooklyn Bridge opens. 1886: the Statue of Liberty. 1892: Ellis Island. 1898: five boroughs become one city. 1904: the first subway. 1930–1931: the Chrysler and Empire State buildings. The city grows from about 1.5 million (1890) to 6.9 million (1930).
description.tr: 1883: Brooklyn Köprüsü açılır. 1886: Özgürlük Heykeli. 1892: Ellis Adası. 1898: beş ilçe tek şehir olur. 1904: ilk metro. 1930–1931: Chrysler ve Empire State binaları. Şehir yaklaşık 1,5 milyondan (1890) 6,9 milyona (1930) büyür.
